chunks: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Mutamatti' (one performing Hajj al-Tamattu') is required to perform three circuits around the House, and two circuits between Safa and Marwah. He ends the Talbiyah of his Umrah when he looks at the houses of Mecca, and he enters into Ihram for Hajj on the Day of Tawreeyah, and he ends the Talbiyah on the Day of Arafah when the sun sets.
ai.seo_question: What are the ritual steps and timing for ending Talbiyah in Hajj al-Tamattu'?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* provides the juristic basis for the distinct ritual phases of Hajj al-Tamattu', emphasizing the separation of Umrah and Hajj obligations. It specifically highlights the temporal markers for terminating the Talbiyah—upon sighting the houses of Mecca for Umrah and at sunset on the Day of Arafat for Hajj—reflecting the practical application of prophetic tradition in Shia fiqh.
